source_claim: The publisher-provided Nintendo Store description for Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach explicitly names Glamrock Chica and Roxanne Wolf among the Mega Pizzaplex animatronics hunting the player.
notes: Nintendo identifies the work as Security Breach, labels the description publisher-provided, and explicitly names these two characters in the game. The page does not state the Glamrock prefix for Chica, so the campaign’s canonical Chica character key is used.
